# Get samples that passed QC

```{r}
load("../../results/01_pre_process/03_probes_QC/SetObjects/rp_sf_MSet.RData")
```

```{r}
df.pheno <- as.data.frame(rp.sf.MSet@colData)

df.pheno.table <- df.pheno %>%
                      dplyr::select(
                        PRESTO_ID, Group_detailed, Group_simple, Gender, Age, Pack_years, FEV1_FVC_ratio_best, FEV1_percent_of_predicted_best
                        ) %>% 
                      dplyr::filter(
                        (Group_detailed == "control es" | 
                           Group_simple == "MS-COPD" |
                           Group_simple == "SEO-COPD"
                         )
                        )%>%
                      dplyr::mutate(
                       groups.in.table = as.factor(
                          dplyr::case_when(
                          Group_simple == "Control" ~ "Control_ES",
                          Group_simple =="MS-COPD" ~ "common_COPD",
                          Group_simple =="SEO-COPD" ~ "SEO-COPD"
                         )
                        ) 
                      )
df.pheno.table
```

```{r}
# Summarize data by groups.in.table
summary_table <- df.pheno.table %>%
  group_by(groups.in.table) %>%
  summarise(
    `Number of Subjects` = n(),
    `Male` = sum(Gender == "m"),
    `Female` = sum(Gender == "f"),
    `Median Age` = median(Age),
    `Age Range` = paste0(max(Age), "-", min(Age))
  ) %>%
  t() # Transpose the table to make each group a column

# Convert to a data frame and adjust row and column names
summary_table <- as.data.frame(summary_table)
colnames(summary_table) <- summary_table[1, ]  
summary_table <- summary_table[-1, ]           
rownames(summary_table) <- c("Number of Subjects", "Male", "Female", "Median Age", "Age Range")

# Print the final table
print(summary_table)
```

```{r}
df <- df.pheno.table %>%
            filter(!is.na(Pack_years)
                   ) %>%
            as.data.frame()
  

df.pack <- df %>%
            group_by(groups.in.table) %>%
            summarise(
               "Median Pack_years" = median(Pack_years) ,
               "PY range" = paste0(max(Pack_years), " - ", min(Pack_years))
            ) %>%
            t()

df.pack


```

```{r}
df.FEV1_FVC_ratio <- df.pheno.table %>%
```
